name: NV-Reason-CXR-3B
task: Chest X-ray Vision-Language Reasoning and Report Generation
description: NV-Reason-CXR-3B is a reasoning vision-language model for chest X-ray interpretation. Fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-3B with radiologist-style supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO reinforcement learning, it produces step-by-step chain-of-thought analyses, abnormality findings, differential diagnoses, and structured reports, and supports multi-turn follow-up questions.
authors: Andriy Myronenko, Dong Yang, Baris Turkbey, et al. from NVIDIA and collaborators
data_source: MIMIC-CXR, ChestX-ray14, CheXpert, and radiologist reasoning annotations
data_type: 2D chest X-ray images (JPEG, PNG) and text
intended_use: Research and education only; not for clinical diagnosis or treatment decisions
references: Myronenko, Andriy, et al. 'Reasoning Visual Language Model for Chest X-Ray Analysis.' arXiv preprint arXiv:2510.23968 (2025).
